result.title: Reusing Assurance Evidence in AI Pipelines: Validity Conditions, a Fail-Closed Release Gate, and a Replay of 714 Public Data Version Control Pipelines
result.summary: Rerunning every governance control after every change to an artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline is expensive, so teams reuse earlier results. Reuse is safe only if each control's declared dependencies cover everything that can change its outcome, and only if the release gate checks that reused evidence describes the candidate being released. This article makes both conditions explicit and measures how often the first fails in practice. It defines when a signed evidence record is valid for a candidate and gives sufficient conditions under which change-local re-execution reaches the same release decision as rerunning every control. A reference gate implementing these checks with Ed25519 digital signatures blocks eight of nine manipulation scenarios, against one for a gate that trusts the planner and three for a gate that only verifies signatures; a dependency the policy never declared passes every gate. A replay of 38,083 commits from 714 public Data Version Control (DVC) pipelines measures that failure mode. Reusing stage results according to declared dependencies avoids 83.4% of stage executions, but in 3.3% of commits it reuses a stage whose imported code or referenced configuration changed, and 31% of pipelines are affected. A manual audit confirms the undeclared dependency in 36 of 40 sampled events. Evaluation stages, whose outputs are the evidence, are the most exposed. Adding each stage's static import closure lowers stale reuse to 0.4% while still avoiding 81.6% of executions; sampled shadow re-execution removes far less, and rerunning everything after unexplained changes avoids only 45.3%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文形式化了签名证据记录对候选版本的有效性条件，给出变更局部重执行与全量重跑等价的充分条件，并提出带 Ed25519 签名的 fail-closed 发布门；随后回放 714 个公开 DVC 管道的 38,083 次提交，测得按声明依赖复用会跳过 83.4% 阶段执行，但 3.3% 提交复用了已过期的阶段结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「声明依赖覆盖不全即导致陈旧复用」的缓存有效性框架，可能与 LVR 中跨步复用 latent 或 KV 缓存时的失效判定与证据变更检测形成概念类比，但该文属 AI 治理与流水线工程，迁移可行性需核查。
